SELECT  
	ServiceOCode=(SELECT SO.ServiceOCode FROM ServiceOHeader SO WHERE SO.SaleInvCode = S.SaleInvCode),
	DocumentCode=S.SaleInvCode,
	Type='SV-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(7), S.SaleInvCode))),
	Date = S.Date, 
	Remark = (SELECT I.NAME FROM Item I WHERE I.ICODE = D.ICode),
	Name=c.Name,
	PatientRegNo = (SELECT P.RegNo FROM Patient P WHERE P.PatientCode=S.PatientCode),
	PatientName = (SELECT P.Name FROM Patient P WHERE P.PatientCode=S.PatientCode),
	Cash = CASE S.SaleCatCode WHEN 2 THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END,
	C.AliasName,
	Address=C.Address1,
	OpenBalance=(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(Debit-Credit), 0) FROM VirtualGL 
			WHERE	VirtualGL.AccCode=C.AccCode AND 
				VirtualGL.date < :ar_startdate),
	c.AreaCode,
	c.Area,
	CheckNo=NULL,
	VRow=MAX(D.RowID),
	VoucherCode=S.HeaderInvNo,
	Header=S.HeaderNo,
	Qty=SUM(D.LooseQty),
	Bonus=SUM(D.BonusQty),
	Rate=MAX(D.SalePrice),
	GrossValue=SUM(D.LooseQty * D.SalePrice),
	Discount=
		SUM(D.looseqty*D.itemflatdisc) +
		SUM(D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc) * (.01 * D.discperc)) + 
		SUM(D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc) * 
			(1-(.01*D.discperc)) * (.01 * S.discperc)),
	ItemSaleTax=SUM( (D.looseqty + D.bonusqty) * D.unitsalestax) + 
		SUM((D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc)) *
			(1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01),
	ItemValue=SUM(D.LooseQty * D.SalePrice) - 
		SUM((D.looseqty*D.itemflatdisc) +
				(D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc) * (.01 * D.discperc)) +
				(D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc) * (1-(.01*D.discperc)) * 
				(.01 * S.discperc))) + 
		SUM( (D.looseqty + D.bonusqty) * D.unitsalestax) + 
		SUM((D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc)) *
			(1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01),
/*	MiscCharges=S.MiscCharges,
	FlatDisc=S.FlatDisc,
	InvSaleTax=T.InvSaleTax,
	RoundingDiff=T.RoundingDiff,*/
	NetAmt=T.NetAmt,
	Debit = CASE MAX(D.RowID) WHEN (SELECT MAX(SD.ROWID) 
		FROM SaleDetail SD 
		WHERE SD.SaleInvCode=S.SaleInvCode) THEN T.NetAmt ELSE 0 END,
	Credit= CASE MAX(D.RowID) WHEN (SELECT MAX(SD.ROWID) 
		FROM SaleDetail SD 
		WHERE SD.SaleInvCode=S.SaleInvCode) THEN CASE WHEN ISNULL(S.CashCharged,0) > 0 OR ISNULL((SELECT SUM(M.Amount) FROM CashierWindow M WHERE M.SaleInvCode = S.SaleInvCode), 0) > 0 THEN ISNULL(S.CashCharged, 0) + ISNULL((SELECT SUM(M.Amount) FROM CashierWindow M WHERE M.SaleInvcode = S.SaleInvCode), 0) ELSE CASE WHEN S.SaleCatCode = 2 THEN 0 ELSE T.NetAmt END  END ELSE 0 END,
	Others= CASE MAX(D.RowID) WHEN (SELECT MAX(SD.ROWID) 
		FROM SaleDetail SD 
		WHERE SD.SaleInvCode=S.SaleInvCode) THEN ISNULL(S.MiscCharges, 0) - ISNULL(S.FlatDisc, 0) + ISNULL(T.InvSaleTax, 0) + ISNULL(T.RoundingDiff, 0) ELSE 0 END,
	PendingCheque=0
FROM
	(SELECT	A.AliasName, A.AccCode, A.Name, CT.Address1, CT.AreaCode, Area=AR.Name
	FROM	Accounts A, Customer CT, Area AR
	WHERE	A.AccCode IN (:ai_custcode) AND 
			A.AccCode = CT.CustCode and 
			AR.AreaCode=CT.AreaCode) C,
	SaleLedger S,	 
	SaleDetail D,
	(SELECT 
		SS.SaleInvCode, 
		RoundingDiff=
		ROUND(
		SUM( (DD.looseqty + DD.bonusqty) * DD.unitsalestax) + 
			SUM(ROUND( (DD.looseqty * 
				(DD.saleprice - DD.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc)) * DD.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND( (SUM((DD.looseqty * 
				(DD.saleprice - DD.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) -
				SS.flatdisc) * (SS.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), (SELECT CAST(DBO.fn_GetPreference('roundsaleinvon') AS INT))) + 
		Round(SUM((DD.looseqty*(DD.saleprice - DD.itemflatdisc)) *
			(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) + 
			SS.misccharges + SS.salestax - SS.flatdisc, (SELECT CAST(DBO.fn_GetPreference('roundsaleinvon') AS INT))) -
		(SUM( (DD.looseqty + DD.bonusqty) * DD.unitsalestax) + 
			SUM((DD.looseqty * 
				(DD.saleprice - DD.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc)) * DD.gstperc * .01) +
			ROUND( (SUM((DD.looseqty * 
				(DD.saleprice - DD.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) -
				SS.flatdisc) * (SS.invgstperc1 * .01), 2) + 
		SUM((DD.looseqty*(DD.saleprice - DD.itemflatdisc)) *
			(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) + 
			SS.misccharges + SS.salestax - SS.flatdisc),
		InvSaleTax=	ROUND((SUM((DD.looseqty * 
			(DD.saleprice - DD.itemflatdisc)) *
			(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) -
			SS.flatdisc) * (SS.invgstperc1 * .01), 2),
		NetAmt=ROUND(
		SUM( (DD.looseqty + DD.bonusqty) * DD.unitsalestax) + 
			SUM(ROUND( (DD.looseqty * 
				(DD.saleprice - DD.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc)) * DD.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND( (SUM((DD.looseqty * 
				(DD.saleprice - DD.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) -
				SS.flatdisc) * (SS.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), (SELECT CAST(DBO.fn_GetPreference('roundsaleinvon') AS INT))) + 
		Round(SUM((DD.looseqty*(DD.saleprice - DD.itemflatdisc)) *
			(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) + 
			SS.misccharges + SS.salestax - SS.flatdisc, (SELECT CAST(DBO.fn_GetPreference('roundsaleinvon') AS INT)))
	FROM SaleLedger SS, SaleDetail DD 
	WHERE 
		SS.Posted = 'Y' AND SS.AccountFor = 'Y' AND
		SS.SaleInvCode = DD.SaleInvCode AND
		SS.CustCode IN (:ai_custcode) AND
		SS.date  BETWEEN :ar_startdate AND :ar_enddate
	GROUP BY
		SS.SaleInvCode,
		SS.DiscPerc,
		SS.FlatDisc,
		SS.InvGSTPerc1,
		SS.DiscPerc,
		SS.MiscCharges,
		SS.SalesTax) T
WHERE   
	S.Posted = 'Y' AND S.AccountFor = 'Y' AND
	S.SaleInvCode = D.SaleInvCode AND S.SaleInvCode = T.SaleInvCode AND
	S.CustCode IN (:ai_custcode) AND
	S.CustCode = C.AccCode AND
	S.date  BETWEEN :ar_startdate AND :ar_enddate
GROUP BY 
	S.SaleInvCode,
	S.SaleCatCode,
	S.HeaderInvNo,
	S.HeaderNo,
	D.ICode,
	D.RowGroup,
	S.CustCode, 
	S.Date,
	S.DiscPerc,
	S.CashCharged,
	S.MiscCharges,
	S.SalesTax,
	S.FlatDisc,
	S.InvGstPerc1,
	S.PatientCode,
	C.AccCode,
	C.AliasName,
	C.Name,
	C.Address1,
	C.AreaCode,
	C.Area,
	T.InvSaleTax,
	T.NetAmt,
	T.RoundingDiff
UNION ALL

SELECT  
	ServiceOCode=(SELECT SO.ServiceOCode FROM ServiceOHeader SO WHERE SO.SaleInvCode = S.SaleInvCode),
	DocumentCode=S.SaleInvCode,
	Type='SV-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(7), S.SaleInvCode))),
	Date = S.AmtDate, 
	Remark = 'Cash Recvd. During Sale #:' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(7), S.SaleInvCode))),
	Name=c.Name,
	PatientRegNo = (SELECT P.RegNo FROM Patient P WHERE P.PatientCode=S.PatientCode),
	PatientName = (SELECT P.Name FROM Patient P WHERE P.PatientCode=S.PatientCode),
	Cash = CASE S.SaleCatCode WHEN 2 THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END,
	C.AliasName,
	Address=C.Address1,
	OpenBalance=(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(Debit-Credit), 0) FROM VirtualGL 
			WHERE	VirtualGL.AccCode=C.AccCode AND 
				VirtualGL.date < :ar_startdate),
	c.AreaCode,
	c.Area,
	CheckNo=S.AmtReference,
	VRow=9999999,
	VoucherCode=S.HeaderInvNo,
	Header=S.HeaderNo,
	Qty=0,
	Bonus=0,
	Rate=0,
	GrossValue=0,
	Discount=0,
	ItemSaleTax=0,
	ItemValue=0,
/*	MiscCharges=S.MiscCharges,
	FlatDisc=S.FlatDisc,
	InvSaleTax=T.InvSaleTax,
	RoundingDiff=T.RoundingDiff,*/
	NetAmt=0,
	Debit = 0,
	Credit= S.Amt,
	Others= 0,
	PendingCheque=0
FROM
	(SELECT	A.AliasName, A.AccCode, A.Name, CT.Address1, CT.AreaCode, Area=AR.Name
	FROM	Accounts A, Customer CT, Area AR
	WHERE	A.AccCode IN (:ai_custcode) AND 
			A.AccCode = CT.CustCode and 
			AR.AreaCode=CT.AreaCode) C,
	SaleLedger S
WHERE   
	S.Posted = 'Y' AND S.AccountFor = 'Y' AND
	S.CustCode IN (:ai_custcode) AND
	S.CustCode = C.AccCode AND
	S.AmtDate  BETWEEN :ar_startdate AND :ar_enddate AND
	S.Amt <> 0 AND S.SaleCatcode = 2
UNION ALL
SELECT  
	ServiceOCode=NULL,
	DocumentCode=S.SRInvCode,
	Type='SR-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(7), S.SRInvCode))) + ISNULL('(' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(7), S.SaleInvCode))) + ')', '') ,
	Date = S.Date, 
	Remark = (SELECT I.NAME FROM Item I WHERE I.ICODE = D.ICode),
	Name=c.Name,
	PatientRegNo = (SELECT P.RegNo FROM Patient P WHERE P.PatientCode=S.PatientCode),
	PatientName = (SELECT P.Name FROM Patient P WHERE P.PatientCode=S.PatientCode),
	Cash = CASE S.SRCatCode WHEN 7 THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END,
	C.AliasName,
	Address=C.Address1,
	OpenBalance=(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(Debit-Credit), 0) FROM VirtualGL 
			WHERE	VirtualGL.AccCode=C.AccCode AND 
				VirtualGL.date < :ar_startdate),
	c.AreaCode,
	c.Area,
	CheckNo=NULL,
	VRow=MAX(D.SRUTN),
	VoucherCode=S.HeaderInvNo,
	Header=S.HeaderNo,
	Qty=-SUM(D.LooseQty),
	Bonus=-SUM(D.BonusQty),
	Rate=MAX(D.SRPrice),
	GrossValue=-SUM(D.LooseQty * D.SRPrice),
	Discount= -1 *
		(SUM(D.looseqty * D.SRPrice * (.01 * D.discperc)) + 
		SUM(D.looseqty * D.SRPrice * 
			(1-(.01*D.discperc)) * (.01 * S.discperc))),
	ItemSaleTax= -1 * (SUM( (D.looseqty + D.bonusqty) * D.unitsalestax) + 
		SUM((D.looseqty * D.SRPrice) *
			(1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01)),
	ItemValue= -1 * (SUM(D.LooseQty * D.SRPrice) - 
		SUM((D.looseqty * D.SRPrice * .01 * D.discperc) +
				(D.looseqty * D.SRPrice * (1-(.01*D.discperc)) * (.01 * S.discperc))) + 
		SUM( (D.looseqty + D.bonusqty) * D.unitsalestax) + 
		SUM((D.looseqty * D.SRPrice * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01))),
/*	MiscCharges=S.MiscCharges,
	FlatDisc=S.FlatDisc,
	InvSaleTax=T.InvSaleTax,
	RoundingDiff=T.RoundingDiff,*/
	NetAmt=T.NetAmt,
	Debit = CASE MAX(D.SRUTN) WHEN (SELECT MAX(SD.SRUTN) FROM SRDetail SD 
		WHERE SD.SRInvCode=S.SRInvCode) THEN CASE WHEN ISNULL(S.CashCharged,0) > 0 OR ISNULL((SELECT SUM(M.Amount) FROM MasterCashWin M WHERE M.DocumentType = 'SR' AND M.DocumentCode = S.SRInvCode), 0) > 0 THEN ISNULL(S.CashCharged,0) + ISNULL((SELECT SUM(M.Amount) FROM MasterCashWin M WHERE M.DocumentType = 'SR' AND M.DocumentCode = S.SRInvCode), 0) ELSE CASE WHEN S.SRCatCode = 7 THEN 0 ELSE T.NetAmt END END ELSE 0 END,
	Credit= CASE MAX(D.SRUTN) WHEN (SELECT MAX(SD.SRUTN) FROM SRDetail SD WHERE SD.SRInvCode=S.SRInvCode) THEN T.NetAmt ELSE 0 END,
	Others= CASE MAX(D.SRUTN) WHEN (SELECT MAX(SD.SRUTN) 
		FROM SRDetail SD 
		WHERE SD.SRInvCode=S.SRInvCode) THEN ISNULL(S.MiscCharges, 0) - ISNULL(S.FlatDisc, 0) + ISNULL(T.InvSaleTax, 0) + ISNULL(T.RoundingDiff, 0) ELSE 0 END,
	PendingCheque=0
FROM
	(SELECT	A.AliasName, A.AccCode, A.Name, CT.Address1, CT.AreaCode, Area=AR.Name
	FROM	Accounts A, Customer CT, Area AR
	WHERE	A.AccCode IN (:ai_custcode) AND 
			A.AccCode = CT.CustCode and 
			AR.AreaCode=CT.AreaCode) C,
	SRLedger S,	 
	SRDetail D,
	(SELECT 
		SS.SRInvCode, 
		RoundingDiff=
		ROUND(
		SUM( (DD.looseqty + DD.bonusqty) * DD.unitsalestax) + 
			SUM(ROUND( (DD.looseqty * DD.SRPrice) *
				(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc)) * DD.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND( (SUM((DD.looseqty * DD.SRPrice) *
				(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) -
				SS.flatdisc) * (SS.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), (SELECT CAST(DBO.fn_GetPreference('roundsalereturninvon') AS INT))) + 
		Round(SUM((DD.looseqty * DD.SRPrice) *
			(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) + 
			SS.misccharges + SS.salestax - SS.flatdisc, (SELECT CAST(DBO.fn_GetPreference('roundsalereturninvon') AS INT))) -
		(SUM( (DD.looseqty + DD.bonusqty) * DD.unitsalestax) + 
			SUM((DD.looseqty * DD.SRPrice) * (1 - (.01 * DD.discperc)) * DD.gstperc * .01) +

	OpenBalance=(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(Debit-Credit), 0) FROM VirtualGL 
			WHERE	VirtualGL.AccCode=C.AccCode AND 
				VirtualGL.date < :ar_startdate),
	c.AreaCode,
	c.Area,
	CheckNo = LEFT(N.DocumentNumber, 20),
	VRow=999999,
	VoucherCode=N.vouchercode,
	Header=NULL,
	Qty=0,
	Bonus=0,
	Rate=0,
	GrossValue=0,
	Discount=0,
	ItemSaleTax=0,
	ItemValue=0,
/*	MiscCharges=0
	FlatDisc=0
	InvSaleTax=0
	RoundingDiff=0*/
	NetAmt=0,
	debit = Case N.NoteCatCode When 1 Then CASE WHEN N.AccCode = C.AccCode THEN 0 ELSE N.Amount END ELSE CASE WHEN N.AccCode = C.AccCode THEN N.Amount ELSE 0 END END,
	credit= Case N.NoteCatCode When 1 Then CASE WHEN N.AccCode = C.AccCode THEN N.Amount ELSE 0 END ELSE CASE WHEN N.AccCode = C.AccCode THEN 0 ELSE N.Amount END END,
	Others= 0,
	PendingCheque=1
FROM
	Notes N,
	(SELECT	A.AliasName, A.AccCode, A.Name, CT.Address1, CT.AreaCode, Area=AR.Name
	FROM	Accounts A, Customer CT, Area AR
	WHERE	A.AccCode IN (:ai_custcode) AND 
			A.AccCode = CT.CustCode and 
			AR.AreaCode=CT.AreaCode) C
WHERE   
	(N.AccCode = C.AccCode OR N.BankAccCode = C.AccCode ) and
	N.Posted = 'N' AND N.Finalized = 'Y'
UNION ALL
SELECT
	ServiceOCode= (SELECT MAX(SO.ServiceOCode) FROM SOReceipt SO WHERE SO.GLVochCode = V.documentcode),
	V.DocumentCode, 
	Type = V.DocumentType + '-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(7), V.DocumentCode))), 
	Date = V.Date, 
	Remark = CASE debit 
			WHEN 0 THEN 'Cash Paid Against Sale Ret. # '
			ELSE 'Cash Received Against Sales Inv. # '
			END + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(6), V.DocumentCode))),
	c.Name,
	PatientRegNo = (SELECT P.RegNo FROM Patient P WHERE P.PatientCode=V.PatientCode),
	PatientName = (SELECT P.Name FROM Patient P WHERE P.PatientCode=V.PatientCode),
	Cash = CASE ISNULL(v.AlternateAccCode, -1) WHEN -1 THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END,
	C.AliasName,
	Address=c.Address1,
	OpenBalance=(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(Debit-Credit), 0) FROM VirtualGL 
			WHERE	Virtualgl.AccCode=C.AccCode and 
				VirtualGL.Date < :ar_startdate),
	C.AreaCode,
	c.Area,
	V.CheckNo,
	V.VRow,
	V.vouchercode,
	Header=NULL,
	Qty=0,
	Bonus=0,
	Rate=0,
	GrossValue=0,
	Discount=0,
	ItemSaleTax=0,
	ItemValue=0,
/*	MiscCharges=0
	FlatDisc=0
	InvSaleTax=0
	RoundingDiff=0*/
	NetAmt=0,
	Debit = V.Credit,
	Credit= V.Debit,
	Others=0,
	PendingCheque=0
FROM 
	VirtualGL V,
	(SELECT	A.AliasName, A.AccCode, A.Name, CT.Address1, CT.AreaCode, Area=AR.Name
	FROM	Accounts A, Customer CT, Area AR
	WHERE	A.AccCode IN (:ai_custcode) AND 
			A.AccCode = CT.CustCode and 
			AR.AreaCode=CT.AreaCode) C
WHERE   
	V.DocumentType NOT IN ('SV','SR','RS','RR') AND
	(V.AlternateAccCode = C.AccCode ) and
	V.date  BETWEEN :ar_startdate AND :ar_enddate
UNION ALL
SELECT
	ServiceOCode= NULL,
	DocumentCode=NULL, 
	Type = NULL, 
	Date = :ar_enddate, 
	remark = 'OPENING BALANCE',
	c.name,
	PatientRegNo = NULL,
	PatientName = NULL,
	cash = 'N',
	c.aliasname,
	address=c.address1,
	openbalance=ISNULL((select isnull(sum(debit-credit), 0) from virtualgl 
			where	virtualgl.acccode=C.acccode and 
				virtualgl.date < :ar_startdate), 0),
	c.areacode,
	c.area,
	CheckNo=NULL,
	VRow=0,
	vouchercode=NULL,
	Header=NULL,
	Qty=0,
	Bonus=0,
	Rate=0,
	GrossValue=0,
	Discount=0,
	ItemSaleTax=0,
	ItemValue=0,
/*	MiscCharges=0
	FlatDisc=0
	InvSaleTax=0
	RoundingDiff=0*/
	NetAmt=0,
	Debit = 0,
	Credit= 0,
	Others=0,
	PendingCheque=0
from
   (SELECT a.aliasname, a.acccode, a.name, ct.address1, ct.areacode, area=ar.name
	FROM	accounts a, customer ct, area ar
	WHERE	a.acccode IN (:ai_custcode) and 
			a.acccode = ct.custcode and 
			ar.areacode=ct.areacode AND 
			a.acccode NOT IN 
			(SELECT DISTINCT VGL.AccCode 
			FROM VirtualGL VGL 
			WHERE VGL.Date BETWEEN :ar_startdate AND :ar_enddate AND 
				VGL.AccCode IN (:ai_custcode)
			UNION ALL
			SELECT DISTINCT N.AccCode 
			FROM Notes N
			WHERE N.Posted = 'N' AND N.Finalized='Y' AND
				N.AccCode IN (:ai_custcode)
			UNION ALL
			SELECT DISTINCT N.BankAccCode 
			FROM Notes N
			WHERE N.Posted = 'N' AND N.Finalized='Y' AND
				N.AccCode IN (:ai_custcode)) ) C
ORDER BY
	Name, 
	AliasName, 
	PatientRegNo,
	PatientName,
	ServiceOCode,
	Date, 
	Type, 
	VRow
